name: Long-Term Residence for Higher Education (Type D Student Visa)

requirements.blocker_text: Requires admission to full-time study at an accredited Bulgarian higher education institution, approved by the Ministry of Education and Science (Foreigners Act Article 24c(1)).
requirements.fix_path: Obtain admission from an accredited Bulgarian university.

requirements.blocker_text: Must show sufficient means of subsistence, at least the minimum monthly salary or pension, for the intended period of stay.
Insurance policy from an EU-licensed insurer required, minimum EUR 30,000 coverage for repatriation, emergency medical assistance and hospital treatment.

outcome.duration_length: up to 1 year, renewable for the duration of study; up to 9 months post-graduation for job-seeking registration

sources.title: South-West University 'Neofit Rilski' (Bulgarian state university) -- Requirements for the Issuance of a Type D Study Visa: enrolment, financial means, EUR 30,000 health insurance, accommodation, criminal record certificate

Bulgaria -- Foreigners in the Republic of Bulgaria Act, Article 24c: long-term residence permit for full-time higher-education students (up to 1 year, renewable) and up to 9-month post-graduation job-seeking extension

notes: NEW COUNTRY BUILD (Bulgaria). Sourced primarily from a Bulgarian state university's official admissions page (swu.bg) cross-checked against the Foreigners Act's Article 24c -- treated as tier 1 given it is a state institution directly administering the statutory visa requirement, consistent with government-portal sourcing elsewhere in this dataset. family_can_join modeled false: no student-specific family reunification provision was located in this pass (family reunification for residents generally requires prolonged/permanent status per bg_family_reunification.json, which a 1-year student permit does not confer).
